__Height:__ 157 cm

Kurumi is the third spirit who appeared after [Tohka](https://anilist.co/character/65259) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/70603). She has a split personality: that of a gentle, mysterious highschool girl with a slow talking pattern, and that of a psychopathic killer. She is very aggressive in her actions which makes it harder for [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) to capture her.

~!Kurumi has the archangel Zafkiel, and has the power to control over time. The reason why she keeps appearing after being killed by [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/72283) countless times was because of her powers. For example, she can heal herself by turning back the time. She uses a gunblade as her weapon. Though she always keeps getting killed by Mana, Kurumi from a different time period appeared and was considered as the most deadly of all took down Mana, Tohka, and [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261) at near end of volume 3. It is said that her ultimate goal is to get the powers of the spirit inside Shidou to kill the very first spirit who appeared 30 years ago to make all spirits disappear from this world. Her angel is destroyed by [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) in volume 4.!~

~!The twelve Roman numerals on the clock in her left eye have different powers that only the original Kurumi can use, but by using their powers, it will cause her life to be eaten away. In order to avoid this, she kills people to obtain 'time'.!~

__Code name:__ Princess
__Height:__ 155 cm

Tooka Yatogami's name is given by [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou) the second time they met. Due to being a spirit, she is always being targeted by the AST and is aiming for the kill; because of this, she hated humans for always shunning her and thinking that she wasn't allowed to live in this world. However, her whole life changed when she met Shidou.  Even with that high and cool presence, Tooka lacks some common sense and loves food very much.

~!Once her power was sealed, she wasn't being targeted by the AST anymore, and she started attending Shidou's high school. Her surname was given by [Reine](https://anilist.co/character/72281/Murasame-Reine).  She was overjoyed that she could live with Shidou now, but knowing that [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261/Tobiichi-Origami) was there too, she was somehow agitated and is always having a minor quarrel with Origami (mostly because of Shidou and their feelings).!~

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Height:__ 152 cm 

Origami Tobiichi is a student of Raizen High School, she is known for having high grades in her entire high school, while she is studying at this high school she is also a member of AST (Anti-Spirit Team) and she's one of the most skilled ones on their team.   

~!Origami is in love with [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257), her love for Shidou is greatly high that she stalks him. Origami met Shidou 5 years ago when the first great space quake happened. Although Shidou doesn't remember it due to his memories being erased by a certain spirit.  Origami has a great hatred towards spirits; 5 years ago when the first great space quake happened both of her parents died due to a flame spirit appearing causing every houses to burn and fall.  At the end of Volume 3 Origami saw the flame spirit (which was [Kotori Itsuka](https://anilist.co/character/65263)) she assumed it was the spirit that killed her parents but on Volume 4 that assumption was cleared by Shidou saying that there was another spirit lingering at the time the incident 5 years ago occurred.!~

__Height:__ 145 cm  

Kotori is [Shidou's](https://anilist.co/character/65257) foster sister. Kotori is the head commander of Ratatosk which teaches Shidou about the spirit and spacequakes happening. She told Shidou how to save the spirits in a peaceful manner so as to prevent the spacequake from happening.  Kotori has two modes which is depicted by the ribbon she wears. The white ribbon depicts the Imouto Mode which makes her show love for her brother. The black ribbon depicts the Commander Mode which shows her tsundere sadistic bossy nature.   

~!Kotori is actually a Fire Spirit. To be exact, she became a Spirit five years ago. The reason why Shidou regenerates his wound and comes back to life is because Shidou sealed Kotori's power inside him five years ago. It was around that time that there was a third entity which was said to be the cause of Kotori becoming a Spirit and the cause of [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/72283)'s, Kotori's and Shidou's memory to be erased.  Kotori's angel, Camael, contains the power of fire. Her weapon manifests itself as either a giant flaming axe or a heat cannon.!~

The second spirit saved by [Shido](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou). Yoshino is a shy girl who is said to be the Kindest spirit up to date. Her codename is Hermit.   ~!Other than Yoshino, she has her other personality named Yoshinon which is the rabbit in her left arm. Yoshino says it's her hero for protecting her from bad guys (which are the ASTs). It is also said that Yoshino created Yoshinon in order to restrain herself from hurting humans.!~

__Height:__ 170 cm

Shidou Itsuka is a student of Raizen High School. He was adopted into the Itsuka family when he was "abandoned" by his mother.   ~!Shidou has the ability to seal a spirit's power. However, the reason why he possesses it is shrouded in mystery. Due to this power which was already known by Kotori Itsuka he was recruited--or rather forced--to join "Ratatoskr" to help and save Spirits. Instead of killing Spirits to prevent spacequake from happening, he has to seal the Spirit's powers with a kiss in order for them to co-exist with humans.  Shidou met his real sister at volume 3 which was [Mana Takamiya](https://anilist.co/character/72283). Shidou, Mana and [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) can't remember much about what happened 5 years ago because a certain "Spirit/person" locked their memories away, and at that time Shidou met [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261) and helped her which was the cause as of why Origami fell for Shidou.  Once the power of a Spirit is sealed within Shidou, he has the ability to use some portion of it, thus his resurrection power is from Kotori's abilities when he sealed Kotori's Spirit 5 years ago.!~

__Angel:__ Haniel
__Height:__ 144 cm (normal), 170 cm (adult form)
__Rank:__ B-Class spirit 

Natsumi is the seventh Spirit to appear in the series. She first appears as a slender woman whose age should be slightly past 20 years old.

 ~!However, it is later revealed that her true form is a little girl with the appearance of a child with unkempt hair and clothing.!~

Miku is a Spirit who is an idol and lady. She hates men to the point that [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) even has to crossdress in order to interact with her.

~!Just like [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263), Miku was a normal human before she became a Spirit. Her angel is Gabriel, and she has the power to manipulate and brainwash people.!~

~!Ever since she was little, Miku loved singing. She wasn't good at studying or sports, but she could sing better than anyone else around her. As an aspiring singer, she had always dreamed of performing on the big stage. That dream came true when she debuted as an idol singer at the age of 15, under the stage name Tsukino Yoimachi. It was the best thing that Miku could have wished for, doing the very thing she loved and being adored by her fans, she was having the time of her life. Her career however, came to an abrupt end just after about a year when she refused to, you know what, with a hotshot TV producer. Before Miku knew it, false scandals about her began appearing. She soon fell out of favour with her agency. Her fans started to hate her, and Miku thought that she could reconnect everything back with her singing, but she suddenly had lost her voice. As Miku contemplated suicide, Phantom appeared before her and made her a Spirit.!~

Often speaks in a robot-like speech pattern; when arguing with [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/86645/Yamai-Kaguya), Yuzuru always sneers at her and points out the flaw in Kaguya’s argument.

~!Yamai was originally one spirit, but for unknown reasons or causes that may be related with her coming and going between the dimensions sometime in the past; she was split into two bodies and mind. The original personality of Yamai is no more, as well as what type of personality she used to have is unknown to the split Yamais. The Yamai Sisters have been well known to the people who know about the existence of spirit because they often cause major storm in the area every time they come through to Earth.!~

__Height:__ 148 cm
__Angel:__ Michael

She is the tenth spirit to appear in the series. Mukuro speaks in an overly archaic style. She often speaks in a third person perspective by referring to herself as "Muku" (むく).

~!After having her emotions unlocked, Mukuro regained her true personality, which in contrast to her sealed one, is very emotional. Due to growing up as an orphan, Mukuro fears to be alone again and desperately wants to remain attached to those who she believes loves her. Even after going as far as to seal the other Spirits' memories of him, [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/) describes her intentions as being motivated by pure love and innocence rather than any true ill will.!~

~!Mukuro once was a lonely child that grew up with no family. In her solitude, she concluded that people blessed with a family were special, and she could not be considered special. However, one day, she was adopted by a couple who wanted a child. They, along with an older sister, would soon become a family to her. For a while, she lived in bliss under the warmth of a family. Her sister would complement her hair while styling it, and they often went stargazing together, as she recited the lore of each constellation to her. However, one day while visiting Tenguu Tower, her sister brought along a friend, who commented that Mukuro needed to cut her hair. Hurt by how her sister had changed from always praising her golden hair, she concluded that her sister had loved her friend more than her.!~

__Height:__ 164 cm

She is highly intelligent and the Analysis Officer of Ratatosk's Fraxinus Crew.  She can be more called as the Vice Commander of the crew rather than [Kannazuki Kyouhei](https://anilist.co/character/75394), it is usually her at the side of [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) managing things around the crew. She transferred to Raizen Highschool as a physics teacher and an assistant home-room teacher at [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s class. She has this very big eyebags which you can tell she hasn't been sleeping for years.

~!At some point of time she can be reliable and take command of the directions which Shidou needs to do when dating a spirit. She acts like the "mother" of Shidou and the other Spirits to help them on their troubles and such.!~

__Height:__ 168 cm
__Angel:__ Rasiel

She is the ninth Spirit to appear in the series.

~!Nia, also known as the Second Spirit, is a Spirit that appeared on Earth some time after the First Spirit appeared and is claimed to be the only one who knows any information about the First Spirit and her whereabouts. At some point, the D.E.M. captured her by unknown means and she fell into a comatose state.!~

~!The First Spirit was the first Spirit to ever make an appearance on Earth. 30 years before the beginning of the events in Date A Live, she was summoned into the world by Sir Isaac Ray Pelham Westcott, Ellen Mira Mathers, and Elliot Baldwin Woodman through unknown means. However, her summoning also caused the first spacequake in history at some point of the frontier between China and Mongolia, killing over 150 million people and starting a chain of similar disasters around the world that would last approximately six months.!~

One of the Wizards of DEM (Deus Ex Machina), an organization which provides realizer units to other wizards throughout the world to fend off spirits. When DEM was transferred to Tenguu City's AST, she was posted on that spot to deal with the Spirit called Nightmare. Mana doesn't recall much of her past and it is said that she's one of the best wizards existing.   ~!In Volume 3 it is revealed that Mana is [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s blood-related sister; though she can't recall much of her past 5 years ago. She has a photo of her and Shidou that reveals that Shidou is her brother. Even though Mana is one of the best wizards existing, DEM has been experimenting on her body via tests and drugs; making her capable of using other tools meant to kill Spirits. It takes a side effect on her body, but she herself doesn't know it.!~  ~!In Volume 4 she was taken into Ratatoskr for custody; in Volume 5 she joins Ratatoskr.!~

name.native: エレン・ミラ・メイザース

node.description: Reportedly she is the world's strongest Wizard who works for Sir Isaac Ray Peram Westcott personally and is often mistaken for being his assistant. She has previously worked for the AST by request of Sir Isaac Ray Peram Westcott. She has vowed to never lose to any opponent, even agreeing that she may go so far as to commit the atrocity of destroying the world in the process.  (Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 181cm

Vice Commander of Ratatoskr. Other information is still unknown except for the fact that he's a masochist and like the other crew members, he loves and respects his Commander, Kotori.  He can be stupid, but when it comes to it he acts accordingly to what needs to be done.

~!The Fraxinus AI. After the ship's upgrade to Fraxinus EX, she gains the ability to talk to the crew members. During the final battle with DEM, she was able to gain a physical form through Nia's powers.(Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~
**Mii Fujibakama** is a member of the female trio that Tohka is friends with.

name.native: アルテミシア・ベル・アシュクロフト

node.description: ~!Artemisia is one of the top five wizards in the entire world. She made a proper appearance in Volume 13 as the new Adeptus 2, replacing Mana, and was there to guard Westcott alongside Ellen. (Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~
~!A pseudo Spirit created through a combination of DEM's technology and Westcott's <Beelzebub>. !~
Captain of the Japan Ground Self Defense Force (JGSDF) Anti-Spirit Team (AST) who leads the young girls of the AST while being 27 herself.  (Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 150 cm
__Relatives:__ [Mikie Okamine](https://anilist.co/character/85561/Okamine-Mikie) (Cousin), ~![Kyouhei Kannazuki](https://anilist.co/character/75394/Kannazuki-Kyouhei) (Husband)!~

[Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s homeroom teacher. Despite being 29 years old, she is still single. Always, when something dangerous happens, Tamae has a habit of panicking non-stop.

~!Tamae fell mutually in love at first sight with Kannazuki during a marriage interview party. Ideally, his looks fulfilled her dreams of being swept away by a princely figure. As of Volume 21, Tamae is currently wearing a ring symbolizing her engagement with Kannazuki.!~

name.native: アイザック・レイ・ペラム・ウェストコット

node.description: The managing director of DEM Industries, He is around 30 years old and a tall man with dark ash blond hair and sharp eyes.

Described as "bringing pain to every rival of her love" and "the woman who lives at 2am", she is introduced with a voodoo doll. One of several female assistants to Shido onboard Fraxinus.  (Source: Wikipedia)
**Ai Yamabuki** is a fellow student of Raizen High School and the leader of the female trio that Tohka often talks to in class.

name.native: カレン・ノーラ・メイザース

node.description: ~!Karen is Woodman’s secretary. Usually, she accompanies her boss to his meetings by pushing his wheelchair. She is also the younger sister of Ellen Mira Mathers, Westcott’s secretary and the world’s strongest wizard. (Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~
**Mai Hazakura** is a member of the female trio that Tohka is friends with.

[Tokisaki Kurumi's](https://anilist.co/character/70069/) childhood friend.

~!She later became the basis for the [White Queen](https://anilist.co/character/148794)'s personality.!~
A woman who's sincere and earnest devotion was feared by the law. One of several female assistants to Shido onboard Fraxinus. (Source: Wikipedia)

__Relatives:__ [Tamae Okamine](https://anilist.co/character/70605) (Cousin), Kotaro Okamine (Father)

A young girl who recently got into the AST which she has wanted to join since a young age. She reportedly had high marks on her entrance exam, but her first performance leaves doubt in the minds of others whether that was false. She constantly says "I will do my best!", and has great admiration for Tobiichi Origami. (Source: Chapter 1 of the manga)

name.native: ミルドレッド・F・藤村

node.description: Holding the rank of "second-class non commissioned officer", she is described as a girl with blue eyes and blond hair who wears glasses. She often goes by the nickname "Mily". Her chronological age is close to Origami's thus leading her to have a strange attraction to Origami. She is a mechanic who occasionallyhe gets delusional about others for her own personal fantasy.  (Source: Wikipedia)

name.native: エリオット・ボールドウィン・ウッドマン

node.description: ~!Woodman is Ratatoskr Machinery's founder and Kotori's benefactor. He has an unconventional method for communication and conversation, much to the dismay of those working under him. He once worked alongside with the current DEM managing director, Westcott. However, He claims to have left DEM after falling in love with the First Spirit, and he left Westcott's side to form Ratatoskr in order to help save other Spirits. (Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~

__Height:__ 175 cm 

Hiroto is Shido's friend and classmate.
The man with a hundred waifus. One of several male assistants to Shido onboard Fraxinus.  (Source: Wikipedia)

Married and divorced five times, he's been given the title "Master of Love". One of several male assistants to Shido by giving a vote on the appropriate course of action Shido should take when acting.  (Source: Wikipedia)
An incubus during the nighttime. One of several male assistants to Shido onboard Fraxinus. His introductory phrase, Mahal kita is Filipino for I love you.
